title: Canonical etale section comparison
statement: For a commuting triangle of schemes $T\xrightarrow{h}S\xrightarrow{f}R$ with $k=hf$, a sheaf of sets $G$ on $R_{\mathrm{et}}$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaf-of-sets], and an etale object $U$ over $R$, define the section map from $(f^{-1}G)(U\times_R S)$ to $(k^{-1}G)(U\times_R T)$ by the adjunction unit for $h$, followed by the chosen unit-compatible inverse-image composition isomorphism [lem-weil-pbc-sets-etale-inverse-image-composition-units], equality transport to $k$, and restriction along the canonical iterated-fibre-product pasting isomorphism. This is the existing map named etaleSetSectionComparison; the definition is relocated without changing its data or type.
